Innovation through formulation.

# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8

Employment Opportunities
Working at Azelis

We embrace change as an invaluable opportunity to grow, learn and become even better at what we do.
As do our people. Azelis currently employs more than 4,100 talented individuals in 64 countries. And
counting.

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains. 

[Learn more][95]
We provide high quality raw materials, sourced from leading global manufacturers. Our technical team
can provide you with sampling, formulation and expertise.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

At a time when many of our products for everyday use are still based on petroleum molecules, AFYREN
is offering to a wide range of industries replacement molecules that are biobased, thanks to an
environmentally friendly technology that uses natural microorganisms.

###### OUR BIOBASED SOLUTIONS

## A vision for the industry of the future

Thanks to its innovative technology inspired by living matter, AFYREN produces biomolecules that
will form the basis of tomorrow’s ingredients. In addition to replacing petro-sourced products,
AFYREN and its industrial customers are part of a low-carbon, circular and regenerative bioeconomy,
contributing to better health for people and ecosystems.

**Nicolas Sordet and Jérémy Pessiot
**Co-founders of AFYREN

[afyren dirigeant]

## our commitments

### Living within our planetary means


**AFYREN offers solutions to tackle complex global issues for responsible development based on a
better balance between needs and resources. We are convinced that the sustainability of our planet
and our lifestyles depends on reducing humanity’s ecological footprint.**

Preserve natural resources and biodiversity
Our biobased solutions help to reduce dependence on fossil dependence on fossil fuels for many
everyday consumer products. Non-food biomass is converted in a reactor by a fermentation process
based on a 100% natural microbial community.
Reducing our environmental footprint
Processing operations are clean and energy-efficient, enabling us to reduce our carbon footprint in
the chemicals sector by a factor of 5. Our AFYREN NEOXY plant is based on the CHEMESIS platform to
develop synergies with the players on the platform: water, gas and electricity.
Reduce waste and optimize circularity
We are fully committed to a circular economy
circular economy, using by-products from organic raw materials as raw materials. From biomass
recovery to the “return to the soil” of the by-products of the fermentation process, our technology
is part of the zero waste approach.

[Read more][24]

## about Afyren

At a time when many of our products for everyday use are still based on petroleum molecules, AFYREN
is offering to a wide range of industries replacement molecules that are biobased, thanks to an
environmentally friendly technology that uses natural microorganisms.

[Read more][25]

## Applications

Discover our biobased solutions that can replace the petrochemical molecules found in many everyday
products.

AFYREN BIOBASED ACETIC ACID

[Read more][33]

###### OUR BIOBASED SOLUTIONS

## A vision for the industry of the future

Thanks to its innovative technology inspired by living matter, AFYREN produces biomolecules that
will form the basis of tomorrow’s ingredients. In addition to replacing petro-sourced products,
AFYREN and its industrial customers are part of a low-carbon, circular and regenerative bioeconomy,
contributing to better health for people and ecosystems.

**Nicolas Sordet and Jérémy Pessiot
**Co-founders of AFYREN

[afyren dirigeant]

## our commitments

### Living within our planetary means


**AFYREN offers solutions to tackle complex global issues for responsible development based on a
better balance between needs and resources. We are convinced that the sustainability of our planet
and our lifestyles depends on reducing humanity’s ecological footprint.**

Preserve natural resources and biodiversity
Our biobased solutions help to reduce dependence on fossil dependence on fossil fuels for many
everyday consumer products. Non-food biomass is converted in a reactor by a fermentation process
based on a 100% natural microbial community.
Reducing our environmental footprint
Processing operations are clean and energy-efficient, enabling us to reduce our carbon footprint in
the chemicals sector by a factor of 5. Our AFYREN NEOXY plant is based on the CHEMESIS platform to
develop synergies with the players on the platform: water, gas and electricity.
Reduce waste and optimize circularity
We are fully committed to a circular economy
circular economy, using by-products from organic raw materials as raw materials. From biomass
recovery to the “return to the soil” of the by-products of the fermentation process, our technology
is part of the zero waste approach.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which

technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of

sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

### A global leader in the essential oils and aromatic chemicals industry

Berjé’s commitment to stability and consistency in flavor and fragrance ingredients has fostered
long-term partnerships in over 100 sourcing locations. Combined with our supply chain expertise,
this ensures unmatched reliability in a constantly evolving market.

[ About Berjé ][22]

## Our products

Essential Oils

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

Upcycled Ingredients

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

#### Natural Aromatics

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

[farm-e1761900668825.jpg]

Aromatic Chemicals

#### Aromatic Chemicals

Flavors and fragrances stem from the art of chemistry. To complement our essential oils, Berjé
offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

## The [berje logo] promise

We’re committed to being your trusted partner and reliable innovator, providing quality ingredients
with a focus on safety and compliance. Our service and products reflect our values of integrity,
accountability, leadership, legacy, diversity, and passion every day.

### 235,000

###### Sqft. Inventory

Our Carteret, NJ headquarters houses the most diverse essential oils and aromatic chemicals
inventory in the U.S., just 15 minutes from key ports.

### 55,000

###### Drums on Site

We maintain in stock over 5.5 million kilograms of inventory, ensuring quality and traceability for
every container through strict internal QC standards.

### 2,500

###### Aromatic Chemicals

Complementing our natural oils, Berjé stocks over 2,500 aromatic chemicals, both natural and

### 300

Berjé offers over 300 essential oils from global partners, ranging from artisan oils like Bulgarian

Essential Oils

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

thousands of publications and by hundreds of clients in pharma, academia and health institutions.

biocrates enables scientists to establish and scale comprehensive metabolomics within days applying

One challenge we face in clinical research is the limitation of the number of precious samples and
the unique nature of each sample. It can be difficult to acquire matched controls for every study.

of reliable and comparable data over a long period of time, so data quality is of paramount
importance to us. We rely on the biocrates platform’s high-quality workflow and data analysis
pipeline, which helped us eliminate variability and generate reproducible data. Their technology has
also proven to be highly versatile and we could generate amazing insights in different indications
using a wide spectrum of sample matrices (e.g. biofluids, tissues, cells). Therefore, I highly
recommend the biocrates platform to any researcher looking to improve their data quality or just

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

یک رسانه ملی و بین المللی برای انتشار داده‌ها و دستاوردهای جدید محققان در رشته‌های مختلف مهندسی است که

"**شیمی کاربردی روز**" مجله‌ای با دسترسی آزاد است که به صورت فصلی (در نسخه الکترونیکی) منتشر می‌شود و
یک رسانه ملی و بین المللی برای انتشار داده‌ها و دستاوردهای جدید محققان در رشته‌های مختلف مهندسی است که
در سال 1385 توسط دانشگاه سمنان تأسیس شد. رشته های اصلی این مجله شامل شیمی تجزیه، شیمی آلی، شیمی
معدنی، شیمی فیزیک، شیمی کاربردی، کاتالیزور، مهندسی واکنش شیمیایی، مهندسی شیمی محیطی، مهندسی سبز و
پایدار و مواد جدید حوزه­های شیمی کاربردی  می باشد. این مجله همچنین مقالات پژوهشی، کاربردی و مروری را
منتشر می کند. زبان مجله فارسی(سه شماره) و انگلیسی(یک شماره) و همه مقالات دارای چکیده و رفرنسهای به
زبان انگلیسی می باشند.

**«به اطلاع نویسندگان محترم می‌رساند مجله *شیمی کاربردی روز* در پایگاه استنادی Scopus نمایه شد.»**

# [Sourdough Symphony][43]

Join us in the craft of sourdough baking, exploring the rich history, science, and art behind this
ancient bread. Together, we'll create crusty, soulful masterpieces right from your home oven.

## Texas-Proud and Meaning It

#### [Taco Loco][44]

Aside from BBQ, another food item that is typically associated with Texas is the lovely Taco! Get
the best information on this Texan (and American) favorite from tips and tricks to making the best
tacos, taco origins, and even in-depth information on the different specialty taco types!

#### [Butter Lasso][45]

Wrangle up your taste buds and get ready for a wild ride! Our blog is dedicated to exploring the
delicious world of cowboy butter. From savory recipes to creative pairing ideas, we'll show you how
to elevate your dishes with this flavorful spread. Grab your apron and let's get cooking!

#### [Lone Star Germania][46]

Willkommen! Discover the rich tapestry of German culture woven into the heart of Texas. From the
first waves of immigration to the enduring traditions, language, and cuisine, we explore the
fascinating stories and vibrant communities that have shaped the German experience in the Lone Star
State. Join us on this journey!

#### [Spurs & Spirits][47]

Immerse yourself in the rugged charm of the Lone Star State as we explore the rich traditions of
Texas cowboys. From the clink of spurs to the lore of the range, join us on a journey through the
history, lifestyle, and enduring spirit of the western frontier.

#### [Searing Tongues][48]

Dive into the fiery world of hot sauces, where bold flavors and daring heat levels reign supreme.
From the rich history of spicy condiments to the latest tongue-tingling creations, we'll explore the
diverse landscape of hot sauces, sharing expert tips, brand spotlights, and unforgettable culinary
adventures along the way.

#### [Mixology, TX][49]

Discover the vibrant, diverse world of Texas cocktails, from classic concoctions to innovative
creations. Join us as we explore the Lone Star State's thriving bar scene, meet the talented
mixologists behind the drinks, and uncover the stories and secrets that make Texas a true cocktail
destination. Cheers, y'all!

## Farm to Table

### [United We Farm][50]

Embark on a local food journey across America with our comprehensive guides. Discover the rich
tapestry of Community Supported Agriculture offerings in each state, connecting you with fresh,
sustainable, and seasonal produce directly from the hands of the farmers who grow it. Join the
movement nurturing community and agriculture.

### [Peak Produce][51]

When it comes to enjoying the freshest flavors and optimal nutrition, timing matters. The “Peak
Produce” section is your guide to recognizing when fruits and vegetables are at their prime.

#### [State Soil Stories][52]

Embark on a cross-country journey through America's diverse agricultural landscape. From the rich
loam of Iowa to the volcanic soils of Hawaii, we explore the unique state soils that shape farming
communities. Discover the stories of resilient farmers, innovative practices, and the deep
connection between people and the land they cultivate.

### [Metro Bounty][53]

Welcome to a fresh take on local farming in the cityscape! Dive into our city-specific guides and
uncover the vibrant world of community-supported agriculture. Discover local CSA programs, city
initiatives, and resources to connect with farm-fresh goodness right in your urban backyard. Join us
on this green journey.

Embark on a flavorful journey as you learn to craft cured meats in your own kitchen. From succulent

friends. Let's get started!

## How to Eat

#### [Fast Forward][55]

Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting to potentially improve health
and promote weight loss.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

#### [The Diet Decoder][60]

Your no-nonsense guide to understanding today's popular diets. Here, we cut through the hype to
explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

#### [Flex Feast & Flora][61]

Embark on a journey where nutritious plants meet occasional meat indulgence. The flexitarian diet
offers a balanced, eco-friendly approach to eating—less meat, more plants, without strict rules.
Discover delicious versatility and health benefits in every bite, tailored for the modern, conscious
eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

#### [Lactose Intolerance 101][62]

Discover everything you need to know about living with lactose intolerance. From understanding the
causes and symptoms to finding the best lactose-free alternatives, our blog is here to guide you
through your journey. Join us as we explore the world of lactose intolerance and learn to thrive
without dairy.

#### [The Pure Pegan Path][63]

Embark on a culinary journey where paleo meets vegan. The Pegan Diet harmonizes whole, nutrient-rich
foods for optimal health. Dive into recipes, tips, and the science behind this lifestyle, ensuring a
delicious balance that nurtures both body and planet. Join us as we explore the art of Pegan living.

#### [Vegan or Not?][64]

Navigating the world of vegan food can be challenging. Our blog is dedicated to answering your
burning questions about the vegan status of various foods, from everyday snacks ([What wine goes
well with snacks?][65]) to gourmet dishes. With informative articles and helpful insights, we'll
help you make informed choices on your vegan journey.

## Keep on Truckin’

#### [Food Truck Laws Across America][66]

Embark on a culinary adventure with confidence as you explore the diverse tapestry of food truck
laws across America. Our guide provides a detailed overview of the regulations that govern mobile
eateries, offering insights and tips to ensure your food truck business thrives within the legal
landscape. From health codes to parking restrictions, stay ahead of the curve and turn your food
truck dreams into reality.

#### [Starting a Food Truck][67]

Dive into the exciting world of mobile cuisine with our essential guide to starting a food truck
business. We'll walk you through the maze of food truck laws, permits, and regulations that vary
across the US, while providing you with a clear roadmap to bring your culinary concept to the
streets. Whether you're crafting gourmet bites or classic comfort food, our guide is the perfect
recipe for turning your food truck into a bustling hub of deliciousness.

## Agritourism

#### [Saddle Up][68]

Embark on a journey through the heart of America with our state-by-state guide to the country's most
enchanting dude and guest ranches. Discover the unique charm, adventure, and hospitality each locale
offers, from horseback riding under vast skies to cozy evenings by the campfire. Saddle up for the
ride!

#### [United States of Agritourism][69]

Embark on a journey through America's heartland with "United States of Agritourism: A State-by-State
Guide." Discover the charm of rural life, explore local farms, and savor homegrown delights. From
coast to coast, we'll guide you through the best agritourism experiences each state has to offer.
Get ready to explore!

#### [Pasture to Present][70]

Embark on a rustic journey with "Pasture to Present," your ultimate guide to exploring the rich
heritage of America's historical farms and farm museums. Discover each state's unique agricultural
past, and see history come alive, from colonial homesteads to the heartland's prairies. Join us in
celebrating America's agrarian roots.

## Growing Your Own Food

#### [Grow Your Own Food][71]

Growing your own food is an effective way to reduce your foodprint while keeping yourself busy with
a relaxing and enjoyable task. By taking charge of the entire process from planting to composting,
you can select the seed, manage soil & pest, and harvest everything on your own. Whether it's a
windowsill of herbs or a backyard vegetable plot, you can tailor a garden to suit your lifestyle
needs. We provide various garden guides, including seed selection information and a step-by-step
gardening guide, as well as ways to make the most of your fresh produce. Get ready to start
gardening and enhance your eco-friendliness!

#### [The Compost Conundrum][72]

Welcome to "The Compost Conundrum," your ultimate guide to mastering the art of composting. Discover
what's compostable, what's not, and how to transform your kitchen scraps into garden gold. From egg
cartons to apple cores, we'll tackle all your compost queries with practical, easy-to-follow advice.
Let's dig in!

#### [The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening][73]

Welcome to The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening! In this section you'll find customized
vegetable gardening advice and information for every US state. Each page provides growing calendars,
recommended plant varieties, and other location-specific tips to help you plan and grow the best
home garden possible based on your area's climate and conditions. Start exploring your state's page
today to unlock your garden's full potential!

#### [Urban Compost Chronicles][74]

Welcome to "Urban Compost Chronicles," the ultimate resource for city composting. Navigate local
regulations, discover services, and master eco-friendly waste practices. Whether you're a seasoned
composter or a green-living novice, our city-specific guides empower you to enrich soil and
sustainability in your urban oasis. Join the green revolution!

## Your Life, Your Health

Embark on a path to optimal health with our treasure trove of natural remedies and wellness wisdom.
From herbal solutions to nutritional insights, our blog empowers you to lead a life enriched by
