# [Sourdough Symphony][43]

Join us in the craft of sourdough baking, exploring the rich history, science, and art behind this
ancient bread. Together, we'll create crusty, soulful masterpieces right from your home oven.

## Texas-Proud and Meaning It

#### [Taco Loco][44]

Aside from BBQ, another food item that is typically associated with Texas is the lovely Taco! Get
the best information on this Texan (and American) favorite from tips and tricks to making the best
tacos, taco origins, and even in-depth information on the different specialty taco types!

#### [Butter Lasso][45]

Wrangle up your taste buds and get ready for a wild ride! Our blog is dedicated to exploring the
delicious world of cowboy butter. From savory recipes to creative pairing ideas, we'll show you how
to elevate your dishes with this flavorful spread. Grab your apron and let's get cooking!

#### [Lone Star Germania][46]

Willkommen! Discover the rich tapestry of German culture woven into the heart of Texas. From the
first waves of immigration to the enduring traditions, language, and cuisine, we explore the
fascinating stories and vibrant communities that have shaped the German experience in the Lone Star
State. Join us on this journey!

#### [Spurs & Spirits][47]

Immerse yourself in the rugged charm of the Lone Star State as we explore the rich traditions of
Texas cowboys. From the clink of spurs to the lore of the range, join us on a journey through the
history, lifestyle, and enduring spirit of the western frontier.

#### [Searing Tongues][48]

Dive into the fiery world of hot sauces, where bold flavors and daring heat levels reign supreme.
From the rich history of spicy condiments to the latest tongue-tingling creations, we'll explore the
diverse landscape of hot sauces, sharing expert tips, brand spotlights, and unforgettable culinary
adventures along the way.

#### [Mixology, TX][49]

Discover the vibrant, diverse world of Texas cocktails, from classic concoctions to innovative
creations. Join us as we explore the Lone Star State's thriving bar scene, meet the talented
mixologists behind the drinks, and uncover the stories and secrets that make Texas a true cocktail
destination. Cheers, y'all!

## Farm to Table

### [United We Farm][50]

Embark on a local food journey across America with our comprehensive guides. Discover the rich
tapestry of Community Supported Agriculture offerings in each state, connecting you with fresh,
sustainable, and seasonal produce directly from the hands of the farmers who grow it. Join the
movement nurturing community and agriculture.

### [Peak Produce][51]

When it comes to enjoying the freshest flavors and optimal nutrition, timing matters. The “Peak
Produce” section is your guide to recognizing when fruits and vegetables are at their prime.

#### [State Soil Stories][52]

Embark on a cross-country journey through America's diverse agricultural landscape. From the rich
loam of Iowa to the volcanic soils of Hawaii, we explore the unique state soils that shape farming
communities. Discover the stories of resilient farmers, innovative practices, and the deep
connection between people and the land they cultivate.

### [Metro Bounty][53]

Welcome to a fresh take on local farming in the cityscape! Dive into our city-specific guides and
uncover the vibrant world of community-supported agriculture. Discover local CSA programs, city
initiatives, and resources to connect with farm-fresh goodness right in your urban backyard. Join us
on this green journey.

#### [Deli DIY][54]

Embark on a flavorful journey as you learn to craft cured meats in your own kitchen. From succulent
bacon to savory salami, our step-by-step guides will transform you into an artisanal charcuterie
master. Discover the satisfaction of creating homemade delicacies that will impress your family and
friends. Let's get started!

## How to Eat

#### [Fast Forward][55]

Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting to potentially improve health
and promote weight loss.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

#### [The Diet Decoder][60]

Your no-nonsense guide to understanding today's popular diets. Here, we cut through the hype to
explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

#### [Flex Feast & Flora][61]

Embark on a journey where nutritious plants meet occasional meat indulgence. The flexitarian diet
offers a balanced, eco-friendly approach to eating—less meat, more plants, without strict rules.
Discover delicious versatility and health benefits in every bite, tailored for the modern, conscious
eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

#### [Lactose Intolerance 101][62]

Discover everything you need to know about living with lactose intolerance. From understanding the
causes and symptoms to finding the best lactose-free alternatives, our blog is here to guide you
through your journey. Join us as we explore the world of lactose intolerance and learn to thrive
without dairy.

#### [The Pure Pegan Path][63]

Embark on a culinary journey where paleo meets vegan. The Pegan Diet harmonizes whole, nutrient-rich
foods for optimal health. Dive into recipes, tips, and the science behind this lifestyle, ensuring a
delicious balance that nurtures both body and planet. Join us as we explore the art of Pegan living.

#### [Vegan or Not?][64]

Navigating the world of vegan food can be challenging. Our blog is dedicated to answering your
burning questions about the vegan status of various foods, from everyday snacks ([What wine goes
well with snacks?][65]) to gourmet dishes. With informative articles and helpful insights, we'll
help you make informed choices on your vegan journey.

## Keep on Truckin’

#### [Food Truck Laws Across America][66]

Embark on a culinary adventure with confidence as you explore the diverse tapestry of food truck
laws across America. Our guide provides a detailed overview of the regulations that govern mobile
eateries, offering insights and tips to ensure your food truck business thrives within the legal
landscape. From health codes to parking restrictions, stay ahead of the curve and turn your food
truck dreams into reality.

#### [Starting a Food Truck][67]

Dive into the exciting world of mobile cuisine with our essential guide to starting a food truck
business. We'll walk you through the maze of food truck laws, permits, and regulations that vary
across the US, while providing you with a clear roadmap to bring your culinary concept to the
streets. Whether you're crafting gourmet bites or classic comfort food, our guide is the perfect
recipe for turning your food truck into a bustling hub of deliciousness.

## Agritourism

#### [Saddle Up][68]

Embark on a journey through the heart of America with our state-by-state guide to the country's most
enchanting dude and guest ranches. Discover the unique charm, adventure, and hospitality each locale
offers, from horseback riding under vast skies to cozy evenings by the campfire. Saddle up for the
ride!

#### [United States of Agritourism][69]

Embark on a journey through America's heartland with "United States of Agritourism: A State-by-State
Guide." Discover the charm of rural life, explore local farms, and savor homegrown delights. From
coast to coast, we'll guide you through the best agritourism experiences each state has to offer.
Get ready to explore!

#### [Pasture to Present][70]

Embark on a rustic journey with "Pasture to Present," your ultimate guide to exploring the rich
heritage of America's historical farms and farm museums. Discover each state's unique agricultural
past, and see history come alive, from colonial homesteads to the heartland's prairies. Join us in
celebrating America's agrarian roots.

## Growing Your Own Food

#### [Grow Your Own Food][71]

Growing your own food is an effective way to reduce your foodprint while keeping yourself busy with
a relaxing and enjoyable task. By taking charge of the entire process from planting to composting,
you can select the seed, manage soil & pest, and harvest everything on your own. Whether it's a
windowsill of herbs or a backyard vegetable plot, you can tailor a garden to suit your lifestyle
needs. We provide various garden guides, including seed selection information and a step-by-step
gardening guide, as well as ways to make the most of your fresh produce. Get ready to start
gardening and enhance your eco-friendliness!

#### [The Compost Conundrum][72]

Welcome to "The Compost Conundrum," your ultimate guide to mastering the art of composting. Discover
what's compostable, what's not, and how to transform your kitchen scraps into garden gold. From egg
cartons to apple cores, we'll tackle all your compost queries with practical, easy-to-follow advice.
Let's dig in!

#### [The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening][73]

Welcome to The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening! In this section you'll find customized
vegetable gardening advice and information for every US state. Each page provides growing calendars,
recommended plant varieties, and other location-specific tips to help you plan and grow the best
home garden possible based on your area's climate and conditions. Start exploring your state's page
today to unlock your garden's full potential!

#### [Urban Compost Chronicles][74]

Welcome to "Urban Compost Chronicles," the ultimate resource for city composting. Navigate local
regulations, discover services, and master eco-friendly waste practices. Whether you're a seasoned
composter or a green-living novice, our city-specific guides empower you to enrich soil and
sustainability in your urban oasis. Join the green revolution!

## Your Life, Your Health

#### [Nature's Wellness Almanac][75]

Embark on a path to optimal health with our treasure trove of natural remedies and wellness wisdom.
From herbal solutions to nutritional insights, our blog empowers you to lead a life enriched by
nature's bounty. Elevate your well-being with each article crafted for your holistic health journey.

#### [Healthy Living Through Food][76]

Embrace Hippocrates' wisdom—food as medicine—for transformative well-being. Dive into nutrition and
mindful eating to empower informed, healthy choices. Our blog guides your journey to vitality with
practical tips for a nourishing lifestyle.

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to

veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.

professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.

* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

[instant noodles]

## [Multi-country outbreak of *Salmonella* Stanley infections linked to flavoured noodle
## products][199]

Over 100 cases have been reported across Europe, mainly affecting children and young adults, with
evidence linking the outbreak to flavoured noodle products.

[field with vehicle]

## [EFSA lowers safe level for exposure to TFA ][200]

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has reduced the safe level of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA)
in the diet based on new scientific evidence. TFA is a breakdown product of some pesticides.

[xylella conference]

## [5th European Conference on Xylella fastidiosa: science drives progress towards sustainable
## management][201]

The 5^{th} European Conference on *Xylella fastidiosa* concluded today in Mola di Bari,
Italy, confirming that research on one of the world's most damaging plant pathogens has reached a
new level of maturity.

[alfalfa sprouts]

## [Multi-country Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouted seeds ][202]

Alfalfa sprouted seeds have been identified as the likely source of a multi-country outbreak of
*Salmonella* Bovismorbificans infections, according to a Rapid Outbreak Assessment (ROA) published
by EFSA and ECDC.

[instant noodles]

## [Multi-country outbreak of *Salmonella* Stanley infections linked to flavoured noodle
## products][199]

Over 100 cases have been reported across Europe, mainly affecting children and young adults, with
evidence linking the outbreak to flavoured noodle products.

[field with vehicle]

## [EFSA lowers safe level for exposure to TFA ][200]

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has reduced the safe level of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA)
in the diet based on new scientific evidence. TFA is a breakdown product of some pesticides.

[xylella conference]

## [5th European Conference on Xylella fastidiosa: science drives progress towards sustainable
## management][201]

The 5^{th} European Conference on *Xylella fastidiosa* concluded today in Mola di Bari,
Italy, confirming that research on one of the world's most damaging plant pathogens has reached a
new level of maturity.

[alfalfa sprouts]

## [Multi-country Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouted seeds ][202]

Alfalfa sprouted seeds have been identified as the likely source of a multi-country outbreak of
*Salmonella* Bovismorbificans infections, according to a Rapid Outbreak Assessment (ROA) published
by EFSA and ECDC.

  Packages：In 25KG/50KG/220KG drum or 1000KG IBC drum.   Storage 1. Temperature: Store VAE emulsion
  in a cool and stable temperature environment. Avoid exposure to extreme temperatures, both high
  and low, as this can affect the stability of the emulsion. Generally, a temperature range of 5°C
  to 30°C (41°F to 86°F) is recommended. 2.Avoid Freezing: Protect VAE emulsion from freezing
  temperatures. Freezing can lead to irreversible changes in the emulsion's structure, resulting in
  a loss of performance. If the emulsion has been exposed to freezing conditions, it is advisable to
  thoroughly mix and test it before use. 3.Containers: Store VAE emulsion in tightly sealed
  containers to prevent air exposure. This helps to avoid evaporation of water and maintains the
  stability of the emulsion. Ensure that containers are kept in an upright position to prevent
  leakage and contamination. 4.Ventilation: Store VAE emulsion in a well-ventilated area to prevent
  the buildup of heat and humidity. Adequate ventilation helps maintain the quality of the emulsion
  over time. 5.Protection from Sunlight: Shield VAE emulsion from direct sunlight or ultraviolet
  (UV) radiation. Prolonged exposure to sunlight can potentially degrade the polymer and impact the
  emulsion's performance. 6.Avoid Contamination: Prevent contamination by using clean equipment and
  tools when handling or transferring the emulsion. Contaminants can affect the properties of the
  emulsion. 7.Regular Inspection: Periodically inspect stored VAE emulsion for any signs of
  separation, coagulation, or other abnormalities. If any issues are identified, investigate the
  cause and take corrective action as needed. 8.First In, First Out (FIFO): Use a first-in,
  first-out system to ensure that older batches of VAE emulsion are used before newer ones. This
  helps prevent extended storage periods and maintains product freshness. 9.ElephChem's
  Recommendations: Always refer to the specific recommendations provided by the ElephChem for the
  storage and handling of the particular VAE copolymer emulsion you are using. Different
  formulations may have specific requirements.

  Packages：In 25KG/50KG/220KG drum or 1000KG IBC drum.   Storage 1. Temperature: Store VAE emulsion
  in a cool and stable temperature environment. Avoid exposure to extreme temperatures, both high
  and low, as this can affect the stability of the emulsion. Generally, a temperature range of 5°C
  to 30°C (41°F to 86°F) is recommended. 2.Avoid Freezing: Protect VAE emulsion from freezing
  temperatures. Freezing can lead to irreversible changes in the emulsion's structure, resulting in
  a loss of performance. If the emulsion has been exposed to freezing conditions, it is advisable to
  thoroughly mix and test it before use. 3.Containers: Store VAE emulsion in tightly sealed
  containers to prevent air exposure. This helps to avoid evaporation of water and maintains the
  stability of the emulsion. Ensure that containers are kept in an upright position to prevent
  leakage and contamination. 4.Ventilation: Store VAE emulsion in a well-ventilated area to prevent
  the buildup of heat and humidity. Adequate ventilation helps maintain the quality of the emulsion
  over time. 5.Protection from Sunlight: Shield VAE emulsion from direct sunlight or ultraviolet
  (UV) radiation. Prolonged exposure to sunlight can potentially degrade the polymer and impact the
  emulsion's performance. 6.Avoid Contamination: Prevent contamination by using clean equipment and
  tools when handling or transferring the emulsion. Contaminants can affect the properties of the
  emulsion. 7.Regular Inspection: Periodically inspect stored VAE emulsion for any signs of
  separation, coagulation, or other abnormalities. If any issues are identified, investigate the
  cause and take corrective action as needed. 8.First In, First Out (FIFO): Use a first-in,
  first-out system to ensure that older batches of VAE emulsion are used before newer ones. This
  helps prevent extended storage periods and maintains product freshness. 9.ElephChem's
  Recommendations: Always refer to the specific recommendations provided by the ElephChem for the
  storage and handling of the particular VAE copolymer emulsion you are using. Different
  formulations may have specific requirements.

## About the Magazine

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

## Redefining the
## boundaries of innovation

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

and asking the prospective job aspirants to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening
with Glenmark and/or to pay a fee for securing a job with Glenmark. We wish to caution the public
that Glenmark does not collect any monies or any other valuables as a pre or post-employment
requirement.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO

link.

GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

[Search Medicines][22] [about us][23]

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

######  

## The Supply Chain Is Complex. We Make It Work For You.

You know that the supply chain can be disrupted at any time…but that doesn’t change your customer
demands. That’s why you need a partner who can navigate complexity, prepare for uncertainty, and
plan in advance so you aren’t left short.

You have a business to run. You need your materials on time, no matter what is happening in the
world. We’ve built a system that serves your market and keeps your business running.

How do we do that?

##### A Worldwide Supplier Network

We’ve developed a network of suppliers from around the globe. Each one has been chosen because they
offer high-quality materials at competitive prices, while maintaining best-in-class turnaround time
and technical support.

##### An Ability To Find Materials

This global network gives us the ability to scour the globe in search of what you need. National and
international relationships give you the edge when materials are hard to find or supplies are
running short.

##### Experienced, Personal Service

We listen and adhere to your specifications, equipment and packaging preferences, and delivery
hours. We monitor your shipment, noting delivery schedules and delay alerts, if any. We record lot
numbers and archive them for historical reference.

##### We Handle The Logistics

Paperwork isn’t your job. It’s ours, and we make sure you meet all regulations and requirements. A
Certificate of Analysis accompanies each shipment. We also offer safety and handling assistance as
well as storage and equipment options.

## Guaranteed Reliability: Protect Your Products and Your Reputation

One outcome of a global supply chain is that it’s hard for you to know if your materials are meeting
domestic and international standards. But we make sure of that for you.

We provide a wide array of ingredients, chemicals and agents tested and confirmed for products
ranging from food applications and industrial cleaners to high-end personal care and specialty
products. We emphasize quality control.Ingredients, additives and agents are tested and confirmed

### Our Custom Manufacturing Network

Our network includes an extensive portfolio of technologies and top-of-the-line reactors,

molecules utilizing multi-step synthesis. Our sales and technical professionals work side by side
with you to understand your process and develop the chemical that meets your specifications and
standards.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Contract Development & Manufacturing

Take your product from concept to commercialization by leveraging our 75+ years of excellence and
expertise in the development and manufacture of high-quality prescription and over-the-counter
products. Our Mission CDMO team brings reliability, resourcefulness, and responsiveness in executing
your project.
As your CDMO partner, YOUR VISION is OUR MISSION.
[ LEARN MORE ][28]
[ Contact Us ][29]

# CAPABILITIES

[ DEVELOPMENT ][30]
Formulation development services, including semi-solids, liquids, and oral solid dosage forms.»
[ Analytical ][31]
Offering a full spectrum of analytical services, from method development to finished product release
and ICH stability testing.»
[ MANUFACTURING ][32]
Manufacturing a diverse portfolio of customer products in our cGMP compliant, FDA registered
facility.»
[ PACKAGING ][33]
Providing a wide range of packaging capabilities and configurations.»
[ REGULATORY ][34]
Regulatory assistance and services for products at any stage of their life cycle.»

# FORMULATING EXCELLENCE

Regardless of the size and scope of your project, our experienced team will create a custom proposal
to address your needs.

# A CDMO PARTNER YOU CAN TRUST

QUALITY
Quality and compliance are paramount to the success of your product. We pride ourselves on our
Quality Systems and our commitment to continuous improvement. Our founder’s philosophy still guides
Mission CDMO today: “A pharmaceutical product is no better than the purity and quality of the raw
materials that go into its production.”
**[LEARN MORE][41]**
EXPERIENCE

Mission CDMO uses our 75+ years of product development and manufacturing expertise, as well as the
passion and determination of our experienced people to produce the highest quality pharmaceutical
and consumer products available.

**[LEARN MORE][42]**
DEPENDABILITY
Your time is valuable, so our goal with every customer is to provide a reliable and consistent
experience with clear communication and quick turnaround times.

## Ingredients that
## make the difference

[Learn more][41]

> ## We are Natara, a leading independent, global manufacturer of speciality Aroma Chemicals and
> ## Natural Extracts for the flavour and fragrance industry.

## Products and Services

We manufacture and supply over 1,000 speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts around the
world.

#### F&F Product Compendium

### Speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts for the flavour and fragrance industry.

Natara manufactures the largest portfolio of speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts, and
its F&F Product Compendium is the one-stop-shop for the global flavour and fragrance industry.

[Learn more][42]

#### TASTE’WELL F&B PRODUCTS

### Speciality products for the food and beverage wellness industry.

Taste’Well is a range of unique plant extracts designed for the food and beverage wellness industry.
The raw material selection and gentle extraction process deliver the tastiest solutions. With us,
there is no compromise on sensory experience or solubility.

[Learn more][43]

#### Featured News and Insights

[View all][44]

##### Company

### When Supply Chains Tighten, Strong Partnerships Matter Most

[
][45] [Read more][46]

##### Product

### Benzyl Acetate: The Foundation of Fruit Flavour

[
[Benzyl Acetate]
][47] [Read more][48]

##### Product

### Natara’s Natural Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate: Freshness That Feels Real

[
][49] [Read more][50]
[View all][51]

#### SUSTAINABILITY

### We are on a mission to make the world taste and smell better, responsibly.

We are committed to being a leader in sustainability in the flavour and fragrance industry. Under
new ownership, we are embarking on a long-term roadmap, setting ambitious environmental, social and
governance targets.

[Learn more][52]

#### INNOVATION

### Innovation is at the heart of our strategy and we lead the way on product and processes.

Our world-class R&D team partners with customers to create unique Natural Extracts and highly
complex Aroma Chemicals that make the difference in their products, and are recognised for their
superior quality and performance.

[Learn more][53]

### We give customers peace of mind

Customers choose Natara and stay with us long-term for the peace of mind that we provide, through
our global manufacturing capability, diverse portfolio of consistently high-quality products, and
innovative approach.

#### Global manufacturing capability

We manufacture across three continents: Europe, Asia and America. As a result we can provide
consistency of supply, contingency planning and regulatory knowledge for all our customers around
the world.

#### High quality, consistent products

We lead the way on consistently high-quality products, and provide a one-stop-shop for both Natural
Extracts and Aroma Chemicals, that makes life easier for our customers.

#### Product and process innovation

We partner with customers to create innovative product solutions that add real value to their
business, and we continuously improve manufacturing and supply chain processes for them.

#### What Our Customers Say

They are a reliable supplier, as you would expect from someone professional and established.

The quality is good and stable across deliveries. I don’t think we’ve had any rejections with them.

##### Materials Buyer and Procurement Officer, Global F&F House

Their sales reps are excellent, very responsive to customer needs, and the relationship management
is great.

##### Former Director of Strategic Procurement, Global F&F House

Their range is very complete in their niche sphere. They have a lot of long-tail small volume
products.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

      The Good Scents Company started in 1980 as a fragrance concern located in the basement of my  
      home. It quickly became clear that digging through file cabinets of paperwork and boxes of    
      index cards was a barrier to acting on creative inspiration. I needed an system for rapid     
      retrieval of information.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
      Unfortunately there were no electronic databases or filing systems available for a creative   
      perfumer. Not deterred I taught myself the dBase programming language and designed a database.
      I entered all the paperwork and index cards and quickly found that this database was very     
      helpful in retaining my creative inspiration while finding the information required.

attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community
* R&D Researchers from Pharma Industries
* Directors of Organizations
* CEO's of Organizations
* Business Development Managers
* Chief Scientific Officers
* Academia
* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
*
